data.description: A dragon horse can enter the Ethereal Plane, Astral Plane, Plane of Air, or Material Plane once per day as a standard action.  This functions as plane shift, but the dragon horse can only bring up to two other willing creatures with it, and only if they are on its back.
data.name: Shift Planes
